title: NYT copyright lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft proceeds
content:
X author: @Paigedays911

A federal court ruled that the New York Times copyright lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft must proceed, citing evidence of LLMs outputting full copyrighted articles and rejecting dismissal motions.
